question: Sl: Circadian rhythm is a term used to refer to the physical, mental and behavioural changes an organism experiences over a 24-hour cycle. S6: Maintaining a good circadian rhythm through appropriate expo- sure to natural light, consistent sleep schedules and times of eating, and adequate physical exercise during the day can allow an organism to live a healthy life. P : Prolonged disruption, moreover, can cause long-term damages such as metabolic diseases, cardio- vascular problems, and mental health issues. Light and dark (daytime and night-time) have the biggest influence on these circadian rhythms.
